body: Planning complete; implementation remains backlog. The sole nonblocking large-ticket warning is MMR-77: inventory-driven corrective work will be split after discovery while full-bestiary coverage remains required. No source assets were extracted, no game prototype was run and no implementation run was started. Next implementation action is MMR-69 source inventory; missing source content and engine capabilities must be resolved through the planned investigation, not assumed.
